title: Fir Tree
wikitext:
{{Tree Infobox |title = Fir Tree |image = Fir Tree |Sapling = Fir Cone |Produce = Fir Wax |Growth Time = varies }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of Wild Tree grown from [[Fir Cone]]. Growth time varies, but like other vanilla [[Stardew:Trees#Common_Trees|wild trees]], there are 5 growth stages, with an approximate 20% chance of growth per night during {{Season|Spring}}, {{Season|Summer}}, or {{Season|Fall}}. The median time to maturity is about 18 in-game days. [[Stardew:Trees#Common Trees|Stardew Valley Wiki - Common Trees]]  Using [[Stardew:Tree Fertilizer|Tree Fertilizer]] reduces growth time to one night per stage, even in {{Season|Winter}}. Mature trees yield [[Fir Wax]] every 11 days when tapped. It can be chopped down with an axe, possibly producing [[Stardew:Wood|Wood]], [[Stardew:Sap|Sap]], [[Fir Cone]], and even [[Stardew:Hardwood|Hardwood]] if the player has the [[Stardew:Foraging#Foraging Skill|Lumberjack]] profession. [[Stardew:Moss|Moss]] will not grow on Fir Trees. ==Summary==
